# steadycron_http_job (Data Source)

Fetches a SteadyCron HTTP job by its server-assigned `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "steadycron_http_job" "example" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}

output "job_name" {
  value = data.steadycron_http_job.example.name
}

output "job_status" {
  value = data.steadycron_http_job.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the job.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `cron_expression` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `headers` (Map of String)
- `interval_seconds` (Number)
- `key` (String) Stable job key used by code-monitoring SDKs.
- `last_fire_at` (String)
- `max_retries` (Number)
- `method` (String)
- `misfire_policy` (String) Misfire policy: `do_nothing` or `fire_once_now`.
- `name` (String)
- `next_fire_at` (String)
- `retry_backoff_seconds` (Number)
- `runbook_notes` (String)
- `runbook_url` (String)
- `skip_if_running` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `timezone` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String)
